page.layout: One page of text, single column; heading centred above it; page number centred below the last line. Small dark marks at the left and right edges are scan artefacts, not notes.

main_text.l: cui si quis sæpius vacare voluerit,
bit solatium:) una est scientia, quæ
quidquid aut est, aut dici cogitari-
ve possit; quidquid esse reale, aut
quæ sui possessorem adeò reddit in-
rum, ut nihil ipsi occurrere, nihil
proponi, aut objici possit, de quo
dicere necesse habeat, se nihil de
eo scire; Quidquid enim in cogita-
nem venit, est Deus, vel creatura,

page.notes: Marginal mark "*" with "4" is the page number; the catchword "tum" is the word printed at the foot right. Small marks at the left (near "Ens") and right edges are stains, not notes. Some ink blotting over "sapientiam", "de", "cogitationem" and "attribu-" makes these readings less certain; the text is transcribed as legible.
